about_the_game:
Undying War: Gate of Pioneer is a subculture-style multiplayer brawl action game where unique characters clash in real time. In fast-paced five-minute battles, players must utilize their characters’ skills and make split-second decisions to defeat their opponents. The game offers various modes, including 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3, and once a character is chosen before battle, it cannot be switched during the match. Each character has a distinct combat style and unique set of skills, making your choice crucial to the outcome of the fight. In team battles, players can coordinate with allies to chain combos and execute strategic maneuvers, creating opportunities for dramatic comebacks.

Angels, demons, and heroes from across dimensions clash in an endless war. On battlefields where light and darkness, order and chaos intertwine, will you follow justice, or seize power? The eternal war that never ends begins now.
